title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Praise the effort you saw
hook: What do you say when a kid tries hard and misses?
intro: A player sprints back on defense.
q1: Do you praise the sprint even though it failed —
q2: or save praise for the plays that work?
q3: What will that player do next time?
t1: No single answer fits every moment. But effort grows
t2: when kids hear that you saw it.
cta: Coaches — what effort do you call out?
ctaLines: The sprint back. The dive. The extra pass.
Praise the try or praise the result?
ctaPrompt: Share your praise habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What do you say when a kid tries hard and misses?
The other team scores anyway.
Kids repeat what gets noticed.
Praise the try or praise the result. Both can work.
What effort do you call out? Share your habit in the comments.
